install.q: Do I need to install anything?
install.a: No. It runs in the browser, on the computer or the phone. If you like, you can install it on the phone as an app.

offline.a: The weekly cell report can be submitted without signal and is sent automatically when the connection is back. The rest of the app needs a connection.

people.q: Is there a limit on people?
people.a: No. Each plan has a limit of users (those who sign in to manage) and file storage; church members are unlimited.

payment.a: Monthly, by automatic debit with Mercado Pago. Before that you get a free trial to get to know it.

cancel.a: Yes, anytime. Before that you can export all the data; after closing, it is deleted after 90 days.

languages.a: Spanish, English and Portuguese. Each user picks their own.

demo.a: Yes. With "Try the demo" you enter a sample church with fictional data, as administration, pastor, treasury or cell leader.
